parts.text: A student investigates the resistances of a resistor and a lamp. Fig. 2.1 shows the first circuit arrangement.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) She records V S , the potential difference (p.d.) across the resistor R, and the current I S in the circuit. The meters are shown in Fig. 2.2 and Fig. 2.3.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Write down the readings. Include the units for potential difference, current or resistance where appropriate in all parts of the question. parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate R S , the resistance of resistor R, using the equation R S = V S I S . R S = .................................................... [2]

parts.text: (b) The student replaces the resistor with the lamp. Calculate R L , the resistance of the lamp, using the equation R L = V L I L . R L = .................................................... [2]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student connects the resistor R in series with the lamp. She connects the voltmeter to record V C , the potential difference across the series combination of the resistor and the lamp. Draw the circuit diagram for this arrangement. [2]

ms.text:
